scripts.snapshots: bun apps/app/sidecar/scripts/generate.ts && UPDATE_SNAPSHOTS=1 bun test --cwd apps/app/sidecar src/contracts.test.ts && UPDATE_SNAPSHOTS=1 cargo test --manifest-path apps/app/src-tauri/Cargo.toml --features fake-claude --test contracts && UPDATE_SNAPSHOTS=1 cargo test --manifest-path apps/app/src-tauri/Cargo.toml --features fake-claude --lib member_socket::tests::the_committed_schema_is_the_one_the_specta_types_produce
scripts.ios:build: bun run ios:generate && apps/ios/scripts/xcodebuild.sh -project apps/ios/Kiroshi.xcodeproj -scheme Kiroshi -destination 'generic/platform=iOS Simulator' -derivedDataPath apps/ios/build build
scripts.ios:test: bun run ios:generate && SIMULATOR=$(bun apps/ios/scripts/simulator.ts) && apps/ios/scripts/xcodebuild.sh -project apps/ios/Kiroshi.xcodeproj -scheme Kiroshi -testPlan Kiroshi -destination "platform=iOS Simulator,id=$SIMULATOR" -derivedDataPath apps/ios/build -parallel-testing-enabled NO -collect-test-diagnostics never test
scripts.ios:test:unit: bun run ios:generate && SIMULATOR=$(bun apps/ios/scripts/simulator.ts) && apps/ios/scripts/xcodebuild.sh -project apps/ios/Kiroshi.xcodeproj -scheme Kiroshi -testPlan KiroshiUnit -destination "platform=iOS Simulator,id=$SIMULATOR" -derivedDataPath apps/ios/build -collect-test-diagnostics never test
